title: iphone_backup_decrypt — encrypted local iOS backup decryption library
summary: Open-source Python library for decrypting encrypted local iOS backups, exporting Manifest.db, and selecting files by relative path and domain.
notes: The library documents EncryptedBackup, Manifest.db inspection, extract_file, and batch extraction.
It is used by the repository's extraction helper but is not asserted to be the exact code originally posted on 4chan without a preserved post checksum.
Verification is scoped to documented library capabilities and versioned source history.
